::: {.callout-note}
Note: Town totals include Village totals. The "local poverty level" standard was initially developed by RECAP and is defined as 50% of the County median household income; in 2023, this was $48,249. The federal poverty level for 2023 is assumed to be a four-person household and is set at $30,000 for 2023. The GINI Index of Income Inequality is a statistical measure of how wealth is concentrated in a location or group. It measures how far a municipalities wealth or income distribution deviated from a perfectly equal distribution. The scale ranges from 0 to 1. A GINI of 0 represents prefect equality or every household has the same income. A GINI of 1 represents perfect inequality or when one household has all the income and everyone else has none. All dollar amounts are indexed to 2023 dollars.
:::
